subject.title: [Bug]: QA Docker proofs do not execute documented artifacts

question: Should maintainers accept https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101045 as the canonical Docker QA artifact-proof fix for this issue once PR review remains clean?
rationale: The issue is member-authored, protected by the `maintainer` label, and already has an open closing pull request with matching proof, so cleanup automation should not close it or start another repair path.

options.title: Review and land the linked pull request
options.body: Use the linked pull request as the fix path and close this issue only after that change merges or is otherwise resolved.

options.title: Request changes on the linked pull request
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers ask for narrower Docker proof, different evidence shape, or additional CI coverage on the existing branch.

options.title: Reject the current fix path
options.body: Keep or redirect this issue only if maintainers decide these Docker artifact proofs should not be part of QA Lab core evidence.

recommendation.title: Review and land the linked pull request
recommendation.body: Use the linked pull request as the fix path and close this issue only after that change merges or is otherwise resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: RomneyDa has the strongest recent history on the affected scenario descriptors and owns the open linked fix branch.
